The '''blistmoks''' were a reptile native to a number of worlds, including [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Blistmoks were pack hunters, pursuing their prey for days before attacking. These reptiles were distinguished by the two fans that rose from their scaly backs. Some, including [[Ura Jen]], had leathery hides.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blistmok_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Blistmoks appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
